notes.title: 🕵️ SECOND STREAM OF DETECTIVE RITUAL OF THE SEA!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44739839/ed034ff715677df5139c239c26d3e1601d533307.jpg[/img]

Hello fans of detective puzzles and the dark atmosphere of futuristic crime scenes!

Today is the day when we put the [b]DEMO[/b] of our upcoming game into your hands. We hope this will further excite you and make you eagerly anticipate the full version. In addition to the mentioned demo, there will be a live stream at the [b]STEAM NEXT FEST FEBRUARY 2024[/b] today at [b]10:00 PM CEST[/b].

Also, check out our latest trailer:

[previewyoutube=Zdon5Po8wQI;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2657240/Detective_Ritual_of_the_Sea/

[i]Step into the shoes of an experienced detective and uncover dark secrets while solving criminal cases. In this thrilling detective world, you'll face stressful decision-making moments, reconstruct crime scenes, and utilize cutting-edge technology for evidence analysis. Your mission will be to discover motives and connections between suspects, spot lies and inconsistencies in testimonies, interrogate witnesses to unveil the truth, collaborate with other law enforcement agencies, gather evidence, and apply deduction and reasoning to solve the most complex criminal cases.[/i]

[h2]Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Solve complex criminal puzzles.
[*] Face high-pressure decision moments (QTE).
[*] Reconstruct crime scenes for clues.
[*] Utilize technology for evidence analysis.
[*] Discover motives and suspect connections
[*] Interrogate witnesses
[*] Spot lies and inconsistencies in testimonies.
[*] Negotiate with criminals for information.
[*] Collaborate with law enforcement agencies.
[*] Collect and document evidence.
[*] Apply deduction and reasoning skills.
[/list]
